environment.note: Dataset 1.2.0 final: after the D24 plural fix. Measured from a clean checkout.

methods.confidenceIntervals: Wilson score interval, 95%, for every pass rate; bootstrap (percentile, 2000 resamples, fixed seed) for F1. Pass-rate intervals assume independent trials; checks within one case are correlated, so metric-level intervals are optimistic and case-level intervals should be preferred.
methods.tolerances: See evaluation/metrics.ts: currency abs 1e-6 + rel 1e-13; ratio abs 1e-10 + rel 1e-10; counts and scores exact.

headline.name: Numerical correctness - per comparison
headline.definition: Fraction of oracle-eligible metric comparisons within the predefined tolerance.

headline.name: Numerical correctness - per case
headline.definition: Fraction of cases in which EVERY numeric and availability expectation is met.

headline.name: Numerical correctness - per case, unambiguous cases only
headline.definition: As A2, excluding cases that rest on a documented interpretation where another is valid.

headline.name: Cell parsing - correct or safely rejected
headline.definition: Fraction of raw amount/date cells read correctly or rejected with a recorded reason.

headline.name: Categorisation (keyword heuristic)
headline.definition: Fraction of descriptions mapped to the human-labelled category.

headline.name: Asset-class mapping (keyword heuristic)
headline.definition: Fraction of asset-class labels mapped to the human-labelled class.

headline.name: Insight correctness - micro F1
headline.definition: F1 over every graded finding-type label (rules, anomalies, trend rises, cash-flow and spending findings).

headline.name: Insight labels - accuracy
headline.definition: (TP+TN) / graded labels. Reported with a Wilson interval because the F1 bootstrap interval collapses to a point when every label is correct.

headline.name: Evidence grounding - observed facts
headline.definition: Fraction of insight evidence items that exist in the report AND whose entity, period and value match the source data, plus numbers quoted in insight text.

headline.name: Evidence grounding - attribution claims
headline.definition: Fraction of heuristic attributions (driver, one-off, reserves) that the source data supports.

headline.name: Data safety and abstention
headline.definition: Fraction of safety expectations met (errors, warnings, skipped rows with reasons, refusal to guess, unavailable measures).

headline.name: Invariants
headline.definition: Fraction of invariant checks holding across every successfully analysed case.

declaredUnsupported.detail: Duplicate-transaction detection is a documented limitation (PROJECT_STATE: 'No duplicate-transaction detection'). Reported, never scored.
